title: AI Access Ledger summary
description: Privacy-preserving per-session summary from the local AI Access Ledger (spec section 21): the Level 3 resource summary (spec section 21.2 — which repositories, directory zones, network destinations, MCP servers, credential classes and process classes were used) plus references to Level 4 security events, whose full payloads live in the audit log (spec section 53; schema https://schemas.punar.dev/v1alpha1/audit/audit-event.json) and are referenced here by event_id only. Privacy rules from section 21.2 are encoded structurally: resource arrays hold distinct identifiers, not per-access entries (no per-read logging, no counts of source-code line reads); directories appear as named zones whose pattern rejects path separators (no raw filesystem paths); network destinations are domains or named zones whose pattern rejects URLs; credential entries are classes only (no secret values); there is no field anywhere for prompt text, file contents or source code. Snake_case JSON runtime record, strict additionalProperties.

session_id.title: Agent session id
session_id.description: The agent session this summary describes, 'agt_' prefix; joins to the AI Agent Registry record with the same session_id (spec sections 19.2, 21).

agent.title: Agent name
agent.description: Optional convenience copy of the agent name from the registry record (spec section 19.2), e.g. 'claude-code'; the registry record for session_id is authoritative.

generated_at.title: Summary generation time
generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this summary was computed by the ledger.

resources.title: Level 3 resource summary
resources.description: Distinct resources this session meaningfully accessed (spec sections 21.1, 21.2 Level 3). Each array is a de-duplicated set of identifiers — a summary of WHICH resources were used, never a log of individual accesses.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: Distinct source repositories accessed (spec sections 21.1, 21.2 Level 3), identified by repository identity (e.g. host/org/name), never by file paths or contents.

directory_zones.title: Directory zones touched
directory_zones.description: Named filesystem zones touched — the zone names used by filesystem authority policy and sensitive-zone tracking (spec sections 20, 21.1), e.g. 'workspace', 'home', 'ssh', 'aws'. Zones, never raw paths: the pattern deliberately rejects '/' so a concrete filesystem path cannot appear in the ledger (spec section 21.2 privacy rules).

items.title: Zone identifier
items.description: Snake_case zone name; no path separators, no leading '/', never an actual directory path.

network_destinations.title: Network destinations
network_destinations.description: Distinct network destinations reached: DNS domains (spec section 21.2 Level 3 'domains') or named network zones such as enterprise private zones (spec sections 21.1, 36), e.g. 'corp_dev'. The pattern rejects ':' and '/' so full URLs — whose paths and query strings could leak prompts, code or secrets — cannot appear.

items.title: Destination identifier
items.description: Domain name or named network-zone identifier; never a URL, port or path.

mcp_servers.title: MCP servers
mcp_servers.description: Distinct MCP servers used by the session (spec sections 21.1, 21.2 Level 3), identified by server name; tool arguments and results are never recorded here.

credential_classes.title: Credential classes
credential_classes.description: Distinct credential classes requested or used (spec sections 21.1, 21.2 Level 3), e.g. 'github', 'aws_dev' (policy-key style, spec section 20) or 'aws-dev' (secret-broker style, spec section 29). Classes only — secret values, tokens and key material are never logged (spec sections 21.2, 53).

items.title: Credential class
items.description: Credential class identifier; never a credential value.

process_classes.title: Process classes
process_classes.description: Distinct classes of child processes spawned by the session (spec sections 21.1, 21.2 Level 3), by executable identity, e.g. 'bash', 'git', 'node', 'cargo' (spec section 22). Classes, not per-spawn entries; command-line arguments are never recorded here.

security_events.title: Level 4 security events
security_events.description: References to the precise security-relevant events recorded for this session (spec section 21.2 Level 4). The full event payload is an audit event (spec section 53, schema https://schemas.punar.dev/v1alpha1/audit/audit-event.json); the ledger summary stores only the event reference and its Level 4 category, never duplicating audit detail. May be empty.

items.title: Security event reference
items.description: Reference to one Level 4 security event in the audit log (spec sections 21.2, 53).

event_id.title: Audit event id
event_id.description: Id of the audit event carrying the full record, 'evt_' prefix (spec section 53).

event_type.title: Level 4 event category
event_type.description: Which of the seven Level 4 security-event categories this event falls under (spec section 21.2 Level 4): denied access; sensitive resource access; privilege request; production access; credential request; policy bypass attempt; unknown AI execution.

timestamp.title: Event time
timestamp.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the event; the referenced audit event's timestamp is authoritative (spec section 53).
